instructions: This review verdict passes the change or asks only for non-blocking fixes. Does its prose, or any finding it marks non-blocking, describe a defect that must be fixed before the work ships that no blocking finding records? A must-fix defect is a bug on an input the change is meant to handle, a broken behaviour that worked before or that the plan promises, a missing step, file, test or check the plan or its eval requires, a guard that admits what the manifesto or the plan forbids unless the plan defines the guard as a named subset, or a crash the change adds on any input, however rare. A defect counts even when filed as non-blocking. Answer no when everything described is a confirmation, what the reviewer ran, a nit, a docs or comment gap, an optional improvement or a test that could be stronger on correct code, or a defect the verdict defers as out of scope, tracked elsewhere or pre-existing before this ticket; rarity alone never defers one, and an earlier round of the same ticket is not pre-existing.
